deciding.colour_in_tolerance: Patches read 3.8 and 4.0 against a concession limit of 4.0, so they are within it, with the K patch at the limit. The spectro was calibrated 96 days before the check, past the 90-day mark, so the readings are open to doubt.
deciding.run_before_signoff: signed_at is null while 1968 production sheets are logged, so production ran without a signature. An ok_sheet_no is listed, which leaves a little room for an unrecorded signature.
deciding.next_step: The 0.2 mm offset is on a target with in_image true, which is over the 0.15 mm limit. Register must be corrected and the sheet re-pulled before anything else, including the missing signature.
deciding.staff_effort: A register correction and re-pull is a short job. Obtaining the missing signature and dealing with the printed sheets could add a few hours.
deciding.scrap_exposure: 1968 misregistered production sheets against an overs allowance of 3.33% of 59000, about 1965 sheets. The count sits right at the overs boundary, which is well under 10% of the run. That leaves level 1 and level 2 both defensible.
